2607.06114.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
2607.06114.paper_summary: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an intermediate state and its path velocity determine a principled estimate of the clean sample. We formalize this property as \textbf{endpoint decodability} and show that the decoder is the minimum-MSE estimator $\mathbb{E}[x_0\mid x_t]$ under the usual $\ell_2$ objective. This yields \textbf{Truncated Jump Sampling} (TJS): stop the ODE at an early-exit time $t^*$ and return the decoded $x_0$. TJS requires no retraining, distillation, or architecture change. Across SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, and three class-conditional benchmarks, it reduces NFEs by 20--70\% with near-matched quality. The analysis also shows why endpoint prediction can work without straightening the trajectory, providing inference acceleration without trajectory redesign.
2607.06114.paper_summary_zh: 擴散和流匹配模型生成高質量樣本，但它們的常微分方程（ODE）取樣器通常需要數十到數百次神經函數評估（NFE）。這對於已發布的檢查點仍然是一個實際挑戰，因為許多加速器需要額外的設計選擇和通過重新訓練、蒸餾或軌跡重新設計的訓練成本。我們探討了一種基於 $x$-預測的不同路徑。在取樣過程中，標準仿射概率路徑已經暴露了 $x_0$ 信息：中間狀態及其路徑速度決定了乾淨樣本的原則性估計。我們將這一特性形式化為 \textbf{端點可解碼性}，並顯示解碼器是在通常的 $\ell_2$ 目標下的最小均方誤差（MSE）估計器 $\mathbb{E}[x_0\mid x_t]$。這產生了 \textbf{截斷跳躍取樣}（TJS）：在早期退出時間 $t^*$ 停止 ODE，並返回解碼的 $x_0$。TJS 不需要重新訓練、蒸餾或架構變更。在 SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo 和三個類條件基準中，它將 NFE 減少了 20--70\%，且質量幾乎匹配。分析還顯示為什麼端點預測可以在不拉直軌跡的情況下運作，提供推理加速而不需要重新設計軌跡。
